scope: Native evidence for the Node 22.23.5 base pinned by production-runtime-assessment.json. Versus the zlib-patched base recorded in zlib-deb13u1-runtime-evidence.json, nodejs/bin/node is the only changed ELF; every other ELF hash is unchanged and stays covered by that evidence and the evidence it cites.
registry_tag: gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13:latest (pushed 2026-11-12T21:17Z), the same root variant as the previous pin.
config_unchanged: User 0, Entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node, Env (PATH, SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt), working directory and 22 layers unchanged; only rootfs diff_ids 12 and 22 differ.

changed_layers.12: usr/lib/os-release only: identical 344-byte content, file mode 0555 to 0644; no ELF.

unchanged_layers: The other 20 layers have identical digests, including libc6 2.41-12+deb13u4, the GCC 14.2.0-19 runtime, zlib1g 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 and libssl3t64 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, so the glibc, GCC and libssl3t64 findings and their package versions are unchanged.

elf_diff.inventories_checked: All 283 base ELF hashes of the rebuilt arm64 root file system equal the corresponding entries of each of the twelve elf_inventory components in production-runtime-assessment.json after this repin; the remaining entries (the 8 Argon2 prebuilds of identity-api, ehr-api and database-migration) come from unchanged lockfiles.

node_binary.signer_listed_in: Release keys in README.md of node-v22.23.4.tar.xz (the previously pinned source) and node-v22.23.5.tar.xz.

methods.layers: Index, arm64 platform manifests and configs of both images, and the two differing layer blobs of each, fetched by digest from gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13 and checked against those digests. Every entry of each differing layer was compared with the layer at the same position in the previous manifest; the other 20 layers have identical digests. The new image's root file system was also rebuilt by applying all 22 layers in order with whiteouts, and every regular file of 4 or more bytes starting with \x7fELF was hashed with SHA-256, the rule of scripts/assess-staging-runtime.py.
methods.release_identity: SHASUMS256.txt and its detached .sig and clearsigned .asc each verify with the key of that fingerprint; the release tarball and source tarball hashes equal the listed values.
methods.forbidden_glibc_imports: Undefined .dynsym and .symtab names read with elf_imports() from scripts/assess-staging-runtime.py (undefined_imports counts them) that are in its forbidden list: strfmon, strfmon_l, __strfmon_l, ns_printrr, ns_printrrf, fp_nquery. zlib_gz_write_imports counts those in its gzFile write list.
methods.aligned_new_symbols: .dynsym and .symtab names containing align_val_t (C++17 aligned new and delete).
methods.pbds_strings: Occurrences of pb_ds, __gnu_pbds or binary_heap in the binary's bytes; strfmon, ns_printrr and fp_nquery also occur 0 times, and the binary names no libssl.so, libcrypto.so or libz.so.
methods.source_files_inspected: Regular files in the source tarball whose extension is .c, .cc, .cpp, .h, .hpp, .gyp or .gypi, the rule of node-22.23.4-runtime-evidence.json. pattern_hits lists those containing a forbidden glibc name, pb_ds, __gnu_pbds or binary_heap; no other file in the tarball contains one either. openssl_api_calls_outside_deps_openssl lists files outside deps/openssl containing PEM_X509_INFO_read, OSSL_QUIC_ or SSL_new_listener.
